# Dhdt

**Dhdt** is a 液态 (连续泵取) ore. Each extraction yields **450** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/zh-CN/formats/ore-fields/).

## 开采

| Property | 数值 |
|---|---|
| 单次开采量 | 450 |
| 开采方式 | 液态 (连续泵取) |
| 触发效果 | 不需要 |
| 地质扫描文档 | definition 8706 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
